options.name: Now
options.line: The arch stops at two bright ends, and a light dust rises slowly behind the guitar.

options.name: Long Fade
options.line: The arch runs on past the arrows, thins and goes out by the plinth, its glow widening as it goes. The dust turns slowly round the guitar.

options.name: Ember Run
options.line: Light runs down the arch from the top, and sparks run with it, fall off the two ends and go out before the glass.

options.name: Corona
options.line: A soft crown of slow rays comes off the arch, like an eclipse, fading into the dark. The dust streams out through it.
